title: 第一卷 第5章 师妹尚且温热第一卷 第6章 深谙兽性的顾尘
content_zh:
身为紫云村最优秀，也是最年轻的猎手，顾尘自然不会错过任何战利品。
更遑论。
他曾听说书先生不止一次提过，修行中人，都随身携带着灵丹妙药。
念头转过中，他的手指已是触及女子腰间，轻轻摘下了一只精巧的小布袋。
布袋上带着浓郁的脂粉气，更是绣着一些他看不懂的特殊纹路，翻来覆去研究了一会，他发现这小布袋不知道是何种材质，看上去很普通，可不论他如何用力，根本打不开，也扯不烂。
难道……
看着那几条如细线般的纹路，他心里一动，尝试将经脉内的灵力引出了一丝。
然后……
彻底打开了一片新世界！
从表面上看，这布袋明明只有三寸来长，可内里竟有着方圆丈许的空间！
“果然是宝贝！”
他心里一喜，仔细看了几眼，面色突然变得古怪起来。
首先映入眼中的，是九条亵裤，然后是十三条亵衣，皆是以轻纱织就，半隐半透……而且几乎没有一件是完整的！
要么带着破洞，要么干脆就是碎布条，被随意搭在了一只木马上面。
木马周围亦是凌乱不堪，堆满了长短不一的绳索，五颜六色的蜡烛，各式各样的皮鞭，不明意义的小球……看得顾尘脸色有点黑。
“这……”
“什么乱七八糟的！”
一股脑将这些东西扔了出来，他又仔细搜寻，最后在那空间底部，终于发现了一些稍微正经点的东西。
百余颗石头。
拇指大小，晶莹剔透，内中仿佛有丝丝缕缕的雾气翻涌，漂亮得不像话。

“难道，是灵石？”
心里一动，他捏起了一颗石头，尝试运转灵溪诀，经脉内顿时传来一阵舒爽清亮的感觉。
细看之下。
那颗石头变得黯淡了些，内中的雾气也少了几分，可他经脉内的灵气，却比先前壮大了一丝。
“果然是灵石！”
这个发现让顾尘兴奋不已，因为这些小石头大概率就是说书人口中的灵石，亦是修行界里面的……钱！
凡人界也好。
修行界也罢。
钱，自然永远都是硬通货！
收起灵石。
他又是看向另外两件东西。
一本泛黄的小册子，上书五个小字——阴阳和合决，看名字就不太正经。
带着批判的目光看了一会。
他发现这法诀比他的灵溪诀差得不是一点半点，干脆两手一搓，将册子揉成了漫天纸屑。
最后一样东西，则是一只白玉瓶。
content_en:
As the best and youngest hunter in Ziyun Village, Gu Chen would naturally not miss any trophies.
Not to mention.
He had heard Mr. Shu mention it more than once that practitioners always carry panaceas with them.
As his thoughts turned around, his fingers had already touched the woman's waist, and he gently took off a delicate little cloth bag.
The cloth bag had a rich smell of powder, and was embroidered with some special lines that he couldn't understand. After studying it over and over for a while, he found that the small cloth bag was made of who knows what kind of material. It looked very ordinary, but no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't open it or tear it apart.
Could it be...
Looking at those thin lines, his heart moved, and he tried to draw out a trace of the spiritual power in his meridians.
Then...
A new world has completely opened up!
On the surface, this bag is only three inches long, but there is actually about ten feet of space inside!
"It's indeed a treasure!"
He felt happy, took a closer look, and his expression suddenly became strange.
The first thing that caught his eye were nine pairs of obscene trousers, and then thirteen pairs of obscene garments, all made of light gauze, half-hidden and half-transparent... and almost none of them was complete!
Either it had holes in it, or it was just scraps of cloth, randomly placed on a wooden horse.
The area around the wooden horse was also in a mess, filled with ropes of different lengths, colorful candles, various whips, small balls of unknown meaning... Gu Chen's face turned a little dark.
"This..."
"What a mess!"
Throwing these things out, he searched carefully, and finally found something a little more serious at the bottom of the space.
More than a hundred stones.
It was about the size of a thumb, crystal clear, and there seemed to be wisps of mist surging inside, making it unbelievably beautiful.
"Could it be a spiritual stone?"
With his heart moving, he picked up a stone and tried to perform the Lingxi Jue. A refreshing and clear feeling suddenly came through his meridians.
Take a closer look.
The stone became a little dimmer, and the fog inside was a little less, but the spiritual energy in his meridians was a little stronger than before.
"It is indeed a spiritual stone!"
This discovery made Gu Chen very excited, because these small stones are most likely what storytellers call spiritual stones, and they are also what the spiritual world calls... money!
The mortal world as well.
The world of spiritual practice.
Money, of course, is always hard currency!
Put away the spirit stone.
He looked at the other two things.
A yellowed booklet with five small characters written on it - Yin Yang and He Jue. The name doesn't look too serious.
I looked at it critically for a while.
He found that this technique was not even remotely inferior to his Lingxi technique, so he simply rubbed his hands together and crumpled the book into confetti.
The last item is a white jade bottle.
